I love meeting new people through tutoring as it is an absolute joy of mine to help people reach their fluency goals while also having informal conversations through fun and dynamic lessons with me where we discuss a variety of topics ranging from our favorite hobbies, movies, news, articles, etc.
teacher_info.about_teacher: I’ve tutored students ranging from different age groups, cultures and backgrounds. It’s always been a delight and a joy for me to meet new individuals and help them attain the goals they want to achieve. I work with students with B1 to C2 levels if you’re a beginner at A1 and A2 levels please choose a professional tutor because my classes are based on conversational skills.  I welcome mistakes because that is where the real progress begins, my job is to give you my full support through the entire process so that you are able to speak English with confidence and comfort.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
My lessons are carefully thought out while keeping the student's skill level in mind because every student is different. My teaching style is interactive and informal. But we can always switch it to formal if required.   
My main lessons are conversation lessons where we will focus on your pronunciation and communication skills. I will have a variety of topics ready for you which you can choose from at your discretion the topics so feel free to pick any that pique your interest.  For example books, articles, movies, or even podcasts.
The main purpose of the trial lesson is for us to figure out what works best for you and if I’m the best fit as a tutor for your requirements as a student.

course_info.trial_description:
If your interested in becoming a student of mine feel free to have a trial lesson with me to see if I'm the right fit for you as a tutor.  My classes are fun and easy-going while also being structured in a way where you can improve your language skills one step at a time.

So I hope to see you in class soon and let's have a chat.

pro_course_detail.title: English Conversation Practice
pro_course_detail.description:
These lessons are specifically targeted at students who wish to improve their conversational English skills during our open conversations. We will focus on improving your fluency as well as your vocabulary. 

My conversation classes are fun and easy-going so remember there's no need to feel nervous we can take things one step at a time and have discussions and debates on topics that interest you.

Please let me know before booking a lesson whether you want an open conversation or you want the conversation to be targeted towards specific topics you have in mind. 

Feel free to choose any topics that might interest you listed below (Optional): 
1. Hobbies
2. Culture 
3. Travelling 
4. Pets
5. Goals 
6. TV shows and movies 

And mistakes are welcome during class because this is an open conversation I will point them out in the Zoom chat as the class goes on so that you are not interrupted while you speak. If you have any questions in regards to those mistakes don't worry and don't hesitate to ask I will help you every step of the way. 

Hope to catch you in class soon have a lovely day.

pro_course_detail.title: Mock Interview Practice
pro_course_detail.description:
In these lessons, I will help you answer interview questions with confidence. 

During our lessons we will practice how to use business English properly and also learn how to formally address someone in these situations.

Please message me prior to our lessons so that I can have the best lesson plan and course of action ready for you and your interview.
